description: Transportation and Mounts system - boats for water travel and mounts for faster land movement. Includes rideable mount entities (horse, donkey, camel), a craftable boat item for crossing water tiles, speed multipliers, stamina for mounts, feeding/bonding mechanics, and mount persistence.
steps: Create packages/game-engine/src/transport/ directory with index.ts, transportDefinitions.ts, transportOps.ts, and transportState.ts

In transportDefinitions.ts: define MountSpecies union (horse, donkey, camel), MountDefinition interface (species, speedMultiplier, stamina, feedItem), MOUNT_DEFINITIONS record with 3 mounts (horse: 2.0x speed/100 stamina, donkey: 1.5x/150 stamina, camel: 1.8x/120 stamina), BOAT_SPEED_MULTIPLIER (1.5), MOUNT_STAMINA_DRAIN_PER_SECOND, MOUNT_FEED_RESTORE constants
In transportState.ts: define TransportMode type (walking/mounted/boating), MountState interface (species, stamina, maxStamina, bondLevel, feedCount)

In transportOps.ts: pure functions - canMount (check if player owns a mount), canBoard (check boat in inventory + facing water), mount/dismount state transitions, tickMountStamina (drain over time), feedMount (restore stamina + increase bond, use animal_feed item), calculateSpeed (base speed * mount/boat multiplier), isMountExhausted (stamina <= 0 forces dismount), getMountBondLevel (bond thresholds: 0-2 from feedCount), boatCanTraverse (only water tiles)
Create packages/game-engine/src/components/TransportComponent.ts extending Component with type 'transport': fields for mode, mountState (MountState|null), boatActive, version

Create packages/game-engine/src/systems/TransportSystem.ts: requires ['position','interaction','inventory','stats','transport'], on interact while holding mount_saddle near a mount NPC or owned mount: toggle mount/dismount; on interact while holding boat and facing water: board; tick stamina drain while mounted; force dismount on exhaustion; modify movement speed (expose getSpeedMultiplier for MovementSystem to query)
Add items to packages/shared/src/items.ts: 'mount_saddle' (stackSize: 1), 'boat' (stackSize: 1), 'horse_whistle'|'donkey_whistle'|'camel_whistle' (stackSize: 1, summon mount)
Add ITEM_NAME_KEYS for all new transport items in apps/web/src/i18n/index.ts
Add achievement conditions: { kind: 'mount_bond', level: number } and { kind: 'water_travel', tiles: number } to AchievementCondition + AchievementSource
Add 2 achievements: 'first_ride' (mount any animal) with 20 coins and 'sea_explorer' (travel 100 water tiles by boat) with 40 coins

Add i18n keys to all 12 locale files: transport.mount, transport.dismount, transport.board, transport.disembark, transport.exhausted, transport.feed, transport.bond, transport.noStamina, item.mount_saddle, item.boat, item.horse_whistle, item.donkey_whistle, item.camel_whistle, achievement.first_ride.*, achievement.sea_explorer.*
Export all transport module types and functions from packages/game-engine/src/index.ts
Register TransportComponent and TransportSystem in components/index.ts and systems/index.ts

Create packages/game-engine/src/__tests__/transport.test.ts: canMount/canBoard checks, stamina drain and feed restore, speed multiplier calculation, mount/dismount state transitions, exhaustion auto-dismount, boat water-only traversal, bond level progression, system integration with entities
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build passes with no errors
pnpm test passes with all new transport tests green
pnpm lint passes with zero warnings
All 12 locale files have matching keys for transport strings
TransportSystem correctly handles mount/dismount state transitions
Stamina drains while mounted and restores on feed
Speed multiplier correctly applies for each mount species and boat
Exhaustion at 0 stamina forces automatic dismount
